title: Word Search
oneLinerQuestion: Check if a target word exists by connecting adjacent letter cells in a 2D board.
explanation: Perform depth-first search from every cell matching the first letter of the target word. Recursively explore adjacent 4-directional cells, marking visited paths temporally to prevent duplicate character usage.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION exist(board, word):
    ROWS = LENGTH(board), COLS = LENGTH(board[0])
    FUNCTION dfs(r, c, i):
        IF i == LENGTH(word) THEN RETURN True
        IF r < 0 OR c < 0 OR r >= ROWS OR c >= COLS OR board[r][c] != word[i] THEN RETURN False
        temp = board[r][c]; board[r][c] = '#'
        found = dfs(r+1,c,i+1) OR dfs(r-1,c,i+1) OR dfs(r,c+1,i+1) OR dfs(r,c-1,i+1)
        board[r][c] = temp
        RETURN found
    END FUNCTION
    FOR r FROM 0 TO ROWS - 1 DO:
        FOR c FROM 0 TO COLS - 1 DO:
            IF dfs(r, c, 0) THEN RETURN True
        END FOR
    END FOR
    RETURN False
END FUNCTION
